description:
The Evanstonian is an upscale independent hotel.
When a guest calls room service at The Evanstonian, the room-service manager takes down the order.
She then submits an order ticket to the kitchen to begin preparing the food.
She also gives an order to the sommelier (i.e., the wine waiter) to fetch wine from the cellar and to prepare any other alcoholic beverages.
Eighty percent of room-service orders include wine or some other alcoholic beverage.
Finally, she assigns the order to the waiter.
While the kitchen and the sommelier are doing their tasks, the waiter readies a cart (i.e., puts a tablecloth on the cart and gathers silverware).
The waiter is also responsible for nonalcoholic drinks.
Once the food, wine, and cart are ready, the waiter delivers it to the guest's room.
After returning to the room-service station, the waiter debits the guest's account.
The waiter may wait to do the billing if he has another order to prepare or deliver.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_RoomService" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/evanstonian-room-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RoomServiceCall" name="Room service call"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_RoomService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_RoomService" name="The Evanstonian room service" processRef="Process_RoomService"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GuestCall" name="Calls room service" sourceRef="Participant_Guest" targetRef="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoomService" name="Room service order handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_RoomService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RoomServiceManager" name="Room-service manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_RoomServiceCall</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Prep_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Alcohol_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GiveOrderToSommelier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Alcohol_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignOrderToWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FetchWine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Kitchen" name="Kitchen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFood</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadyCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Ready_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverToRoom</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Billing_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Billing_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OtherOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitGuestAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Billed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall" name="Room service called">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RoomServiceCall" messageRef="Msg_RoomServiceCall"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Take down order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitTicket" name="Submit order ticket to kitchen"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prep_Split" name="Start preparation"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Prepare food"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Alcohol_Split" name="Order includes wine or other alcoholic beverage?" default="Flow_NoAlcohol"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier" name="Give order to sommelier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchWine" name="Fetch wine and prepare other alcoholic beverages"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Alcohol_Merge" name="Alcohol handling done"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter" name="Assign order to waiter"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadyCart" name="Ready cart (tablecloth and silverware)"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Ready_Join" name="Food, wine and cart ready"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverToRoom" name="Deliver food, wine and cart to guest room"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Billing_Merge" name="Return to room-service station"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Billing_Split" name="Waiter has another order to prepare or deliver?" default="Flow_DebitNow"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OtherOrder" name="Prepare or deliver other order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitGuestAccount" name="Debit guest account"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Billed" name="Guest account debited"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SubmitTicket" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="Yes (about 80% of orders)" sourceRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Split" targetRef="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">includesAlcoholicBeverage == true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAlcohol" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier" targetRef="Task_FetchWine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_FetchWine" targetRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Merge" targetRef="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Ready_Join" targetRef="Task_DeliverToRoom"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_DeliverToRoom" targetRef="Gateway_Billing_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Billing_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Billing_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" name="Yes (postpone billing)" sourceRef="Gateway_Billing_Split" targetRef="Task_OtherOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">hasAnotherOrderPending == true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DebitNow" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Billing_Split" targetRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_OtherOrder" targetRef="Gateway_Billing_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount" targetRef="EndEvent_Billed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
